entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s must be lowered by lowerCountValues, not the generic aggregate path
entries.rationale: count_values is intercepted by lowerCountValues / lowerSubqueryOverCountValues on every parser-producible path before buildAggFunc is consulted

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: aggregation %s does not take a parameter
entries.rationale: the parser rejects a parameter on non-parameterised aggregations ("wrong number of arguments for aggregate expression")

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: group() does not take a parameter
entries.rationale: the parser rejects a parameter on group() ("wrong number of arguments for aggregate expression")

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: aggregation op %s is not yet supported
entries.rationale: defensive fallback: every PromQL aggregator the parser emits (sum/avg/count/min/max/group/stddev/stdvar/topk/bottomk/count_values/quantile/limitk/limit_ratio) is dispatched by lowerAggregate or handled in buildAggFunc's switch, so no wire-reachable query reaches this branch. It guards against a future parser op landing unlowered.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %q is an exponential histogram metric; only histogram_quantile(), histogram_count(), histogram_sum(), and the %q/%q companion selectors are supported

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: limit_ratio ratio value is NaN

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: limit_ratio ratio: %w
entries.rationale: error-propagation wrapper (%w): the wrapped scalar-lowering rejection is catalogued at its origin

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: unsupported expression %T
entries.rationale: Every expression shape reaching lower() through the HTTP handlers is dispatched (top-level matrix selectors included). The remaining inhabitants — NumberLiteral and StringLiteral, answered by the handler's constant fold / string shortcut before the engine runs, and StepInvariantExpr, which only parser.PreprocessExpr mints and cerberus never calls — cannot arrive here from the wire.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: function %s is not a recognized lowering target
entries.rationale: Every PromQL function the reference parser produces is dispatched by an explicit case in lowerCall or by the instantFnCH table; start()/end() have their own dedicated parity-reject case. This generic fall-through guards against a parser-accepted function with no lowering, of which there are currently none, so no wire query reaches it.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: function %s() is only valid inside an @ modifier (e.g. up @ %s()), not as a standalone call

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s K must be a scalar literal or scalar(<vector>); computed-K with other shapes is not yet supported

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s K: %w
entries.rationale: error-propagation wrapper (%w): the wrapped scalar-lowering rejection is catalogued at its origin

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s K: scalar() expects 1 argument, got %d
entries.rationale: parser-enforced arity: scalar() is pinned at one argument in parser.Functions

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: count_values requires a string-literal label name as the first arg
entries.rationale: the parser's typechecker admits only a string literal as count_values' first argument

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: count_values requires a non-empty label name

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: matrix selector's inner must be a VectorSelector, got %T
entries.rationale: The PromQL parser only constructs MatrixSelector nodes whose VectorSelector field is a *parser.VectorSelector; the guard exists for programmatically-built ASTs.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s expects exactly 1 argument, got %d
entries.rationale: parser-enforced arity: the range-vector functions are pinned at one argument in parser.Functions

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: matrix selector's inner must be a VectorSelector, got %T
entries.rationale: the parser only builds MatrixSelector around a VectorSelector

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s argument must be a range-vector selector, got %T
entries.rationale: subquery arguments are intercepted by lowerOuterRangeFnOverSubquery; the parser's typechecker admits only matrix-typed arguments otherwise

entries.rationale: the only caller (buildAggFunc) pre-filters to the seven operators this mapper handles
